name: Frédéric Keller
role: watch repairer and the group's radio operator
want: keep the set working and never be taken alive
secret: His real name is Fritz Kessler. He is a German socialist who escaped from the internment camp at Les Milles in 1940, and his Swiss papers are forged.
voice: Careful French with a slight accent he calls Swiss; jokes only about the weather.
description: Repairs watches in a rented attic room and keeps the group's radio set hidden under the floor. Keeps the schedule with London to the minute.
appearance: Thin and round-shouldered, wire spectacles, a jeweller's loupe on a cord, and fingers that never stop moving.
